limited_decision_effect.established: Planner requests carried source character-dynamics-htn-v1 and selected target UIDs; each was accepted into the native recruitment task, started by the native leader brain, and reached native message-action enqueue.
not_established: hired-member following or persistent relationship change
completion of the four-member planner goal
limited_decision_effect.interpretation_boundary: Planner influence is limited to request/target selection. Native leader behavior executes the task; recipient handling and Job state are native. No Hire was observed.

static_loaded_msg_path.dispatch: Synchronous OnTick handlers run in binding insertion order. SimulateNpcs routes currently queued Msg actions into recipient inbox before NpcAi executes.
static_loaded_msg_path.risk: A Msg emitted by NpcAi after SimulateNpcs can be taken by same-pass Loaded ECS synchronization into the Agent action queue; Agent handle_rtsim_actions has an empty Msg arm. A/recruit patches preserve this path.
static_loaded_msg_path.missing_instrumentation: Raw events do not record per-message Agent dequeue or target inbox insertion, so static flow plus no Hire is not direct event-level proof of loss.

caveats: external_lease_active is the Talk lease indicator and does not measure the native recruit task.
Five expires-after-message outcomes and the sixth wall-cap-censored request do not establish NPC refusal; the recipient may not have received the Msg.
No Hired-member state means follow behavior and full HTN causal completion cannot be evaluated.
The planner's predicted hire counts are predictions, not observed world state.
